versions.content: If the TLS connection references TlsCiphersuiteDefinition of type TLS_VERSION_V13, then TLS V1.3 shall be the preferred protocol version. Only if this fails and ciphersuites for TLS V1.2 are also assigned to the TLS connection, then a downgrade operation to TLS V1.2 shall be allowed.
